_comment: Venezuela leaf slice 5 (v365). The new subject key venezuela_policy (🇻🇪 Venezuela, under Foreign Policy & National Security, no pole) holds the four acts in the archive whose own subject is Venezuela: S.J.Res. 90 and S.J.Res. 98 of the 119th (Senate war-powers resolutions directed at hostilities within or against Venezuela) and Executive Orders 14245 and 14373. Each mapping is secondary, beside the act's existing rows, in db/vr-issue-seed.json, db/exec-action-seed.json and migration 20261116000000_vr_venezuela_policy_issue_key. Each pair carries one effect line, stored once in _DOS_EFFECT or _DOS_EXEC_EFFECT under the VENEZUELA LEAF SLICE 5 marker and written from that pair's own stored text; `source` quotes it. The vote lines follow the tense and roll of the same act's lines on its other leaves. `excluded` lists acts that touch Venezuela without naming it as their subject. No score, weight or existing mapping is read from or written to here.

excluded.why: A war-powers resolution that names no theatre; it keeps its restraint, war-powers and defense rows and gets no Venezuela row.
A proclamation against cartel organizations across the whole Western Hemisphere; Venezuela is not its subject.

rows.line: Would have ordered U.S. forces out of hostilities against Venezuela Congress had not authorized; the Senate refused to discharge it 49-51.

source.text: Venezuela is the resolution's own subject: its operative section directs removal of U.S. forces from hostilities within or against Venezuela that Congress has not authorized. Filed here alongside its restraint, war-powers and defense rows, not in place of them; no side is read on this key.

rows.line: Would order U.S. forces out of hostilities against Venezuela that Congress has not authorized; the Senate voted 52-47 to discharge it.

source.text: Venezuela is the resolution's own subject: its operative section directs removal of U.S. forces from hostilities within or against Venezuela that Congress has not authorized. Filed here alongside its restraint, war-powers and defense rows, not in place of them; no side is read on this key.

rows.line: Authorized a 25 percent duty on goods from any country found to buy oil from Venezuela, directly or indirectly.

source.text: Authorized a 25 percent duty on goods from any country found to import Venezuelan oil, directly or indirectly.

rows.line: Voided any court attachment of Venezuelan oil revenue held by the United States and kept it in Treasury custody for Venezuela’s government.

source.text: Declared a national emergency over Venezuelan oil revenue held by the United States, voided any court attachment of it and held it in Treasury custody for the Government of Venezuela.
